title.en: Get the access permissions of a file

descriptions.zh:
**版本控制**

调用GetObjectACL接口时，默认只能获取Object当前版本的ACL。您可以通过指定versionId参数来获取指定Object版本的ACL。如果Object的对应版本为删除标记（Delete Marker），则OSS将返回404 Not Found。

>如果一个Object从未设置过ACL，则调用GetObjectACL时，返回的ObjectACL为default，表示该Object的ACL遵循Bucket ACL。即如果Bucket的访问权限是private，则该Object的访问权限也是private。
descriptions.en:
**Versioning**

When you invoke the GetObjectACL operation, only the ACL of the current version of the object is returned by default. You can specify the versionId parameter to query the ACL of a specific object version. If the specified version is a delete marker, OSS returns 404 Not Found.

>If an ACL has never been configured in Settings for an object, the ObjectACL returned by invoking GetObjectACL is default, which indicates that the ACL of the object follows the bucket ACL. For example, if the access permissions of the bucket is private, the access permissions of the object is also private.
